name: Alexandre "Alex" Monteiro
office: City of Hawthorne, Member of the City Council

items.text: Alexandre Monteiro has been a Hawthorne City Council member since 2018. He previously served on the Hawthorne School District Board of Trustees for 12 years. He holds bachelor's and master's degrees in education and counseling. He runs two nonprofits: Moneta Gardens Improvement, Inc. and South Bay Universal Child Development Center. His official goals include public safety, business development, homeownership, infrastructure upgrades, and education partnerships.

items.text: He says the city has balanced its annual budget since 2018 and saved about $8 million a year by restructuring its CalPERS liability. He also says he helped grow funding to support people without homes from $40,000 to $500,000 and secured $6 million to build 92 low-income apartments.
